name: TRAPPIST-1d
tagline: El pi leger dels set — un mondo subterestre al margen de la chalor.
history: TRAPPIST-1d is the runt of the chain — lighter than any other planet in the system, with a density low enough to suggest a lighter mantle or a volatile-rich composition. It straddles the inner boundary of the temperate zone: models place it near the runaway-greenhouse threshold, so it is either a dry rock or a steamy remnant depending on how much atmosphere survived the star's youth. Its gentle 3:2 rhythm with c makes the transit-timing waltz of the inner trio one of the cleanest resonance patterns ever measured.
